`presentationProfile.DevMode bool` (and the corresponding `profilePage.DevMode`/`devMode`/`dev_mode` plumbing) is a bare-adjective boolean configuration field on a persisted model, violating RULE-GOLANG-BOOL-002's `Is<X>Active` naming requirement.

`if body == "" && audience == audienceCasual && language == languageGerman {` chains two `&&` operators in one `if` condition, violating RULE-GOLANG-COND-001's 'at most one binary boolean operator' rule.

New function `func (st *presentationStore) saveProfileSelection(audience, language string, devMode bool) error` orders its parameters `audience, language, devMode`, which is not alphabetical (correct order is `audience, devMode, language`), violating RULE-GOLANG-CALL-003.
New function `func writeFileAtomic(path, content string) error` orders its parameters `path, content`, which is not alphabetical (`content` < `path`), violating RULE-GOLANG-CALL-003.
A 5-argument fmt.Sprintf call is written on a single line instead of one argument per line with a trailing comma, violating RULE-GOLANG-CALL-002.
